_policy: Pre-registered targets for the Q4 section-boundary rework (#2080), frozen BEFORE any DSP change lands. Same discipline as q3_key_frozen.json: numbers move or the change reverts. Constant selection reads the TUNE half only; the holdout half is scored once, at the end of the round. Split rule: int(sha256(track_id),16) % 2 == 0 -> tune (canonical: analyze_predict_drop.py is_tune). chosen_config stays null until the final report-card commit.
_diagnosis: At 3.74 estimated boundaries against 12.32 references, recall is capped at 0.30 EVEN WITH PERFECT PRECISION — the deficit is emission volume before it is placement. Two causes: (1) the Foote novelty curve in audio/structure.rs is never turned into boundary events at all, since the only producer of a /section change is the label state machine in signal/section.rs and emitter.rs suppresses same-label emission; (2) the curve is self-normalized by a decaying running max, which saturates to 1.0 exactly when the material is STABLE (the defect analyze/structure_offline.rs documents as #1973 and deliberately does not inherit).

split._balance_check: tune boundary_3_0s.f .1039 vs holdout .1063 — a .0024 gap, so the split carries no material difficulty bias.
split._provenance: binary 38a932cb, cached full-run results bench/out/results/harmonix, commit 09132c0, 2026-08-11

targets.holdout_boundary_3_0s_p: >= 0.35 (ANTI-CHEAT: emitting a boundary every 6 s reaches F ~= .42 at P ~= .27 on recall alone. This floor makes the degenerate strategy fail, and demands real improvement over the .3049 baseline rather than volume. Same move as Q3's major_mode_recall floor catching the always-minor cheat.)
targets.n_est_segments_mean: within [7.4, 18.5], i.e. 0.6x-1.5x the 12.32 reference mean (second anti-cheat, on emission volume directly)
targets.pairwise_f: >= 0.4582 (must not regress; splitting segments should trade the inflated R .9162 for precision, so F should rise or hold)
targets.fixture: bench/check_fixture.py green at ratcheted structure floors (current: pairwise .649, boundary@3s .40 on the synthetic fixture)
targets.guard_datasets: harmonix beat-F/downbeat-F/tempo-acc1, ballroom beat-F, giantsteps_tempo acc1, giantsteps_key score_mean each within 0.02 of the #2077 report card (as regenerated after Q3), or the regression is stated and explicitly accepted with rationale

_scope_note: Measured on Harmonix alone. SALAMI (#2085) is NOT in this round, so the generalization claim rests entirely on the frozen holdout and must be stated that way in the report card.
iteration_cmd: bench/sweep_structure.py bench/datasets/harmonix --stage <stage>   # replay over tune-half sidecars from bench/dump_structure_sidecar.py; validate with --validate before trusting any number
